rooms.name: Inside a giant pinball machine
rooms.desc:
Through the black swirling vortex around you, you manage to force your way into this giant pinball machine, an electricly swirling place of colors, light
and most of all, sound. The noise is deafening in here! Bells, whistles, and 
a thundrous roar pound down around you, all making for a nice nap.
Lightning strikes the plastic ground and fizzles into a lump of molten goo.

rooms.name: Like, dead and stuff.
rooms.desc: Lightning strikes no more than 2 inches from your head!

rooms.name: a room for hidden mobs
rooms.desc: you aint sposed to see this

rooms.name: In the Ball Slot
rooms.desc:
Three Immensely huge silver spheres are lined up in the valley that creates
a slot for the spheres to rest. An enormous spring like device is to the south, ready to catapult the lead sphere at any moment, better get out of here before
that happens.

rooms.name: In the Vineyard
rooms.desc:
You stand amid acres of green vines, growing from bare moist soil.
The mist on the horizons refracts the sunlight into octagons and rainbows, 
and the green mountains surrounding this valley enhance the effect. Deeply
rooted vines with lush full grapes hanging on them have grown to almost over-
flow the dark wooden trellises.
